title: Zesty Fluffy Korean Yogurt Tteok
description: A fermented and fluffy Korean dish made with yogurt and braise, often served as a hangover cure, this gluten-free friendly tteok is a unique and delicious treat. It is typically served at breakfast or as a snack.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine Korean rice flour, yogurt, water, salt, sugar, and active dry yeast, and mix until a smooth batter forms.
Knead the batter for 10 minutes until it becomes elastic and shiny.
Place the batter in a warm place and let it ferment for 2 hours, or until it has doubled in size.
Preheat a steamer basket over boiling water, and line it with parchment paper.
Punch down the fermented batter and shape it into small cylindrical shapes.
Place the shaped tteok in the steamer basket, leaving some space between each piece.
Steam the tteok for 15 minutes, or until it is cooked through and fluffy.
While the tteok is steaming, heat the braise sauce and sesame oil in a small saucepan over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and chopped green onion to the saucepan and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Once the tteok is cooked, remove it from the steamer and brush it with the braise sauce mixture.
